description: Prompt bank for the eval-set expansion (requirements/eval_set_expansion.md). Classes P1-P6. styleGuide: 'form' = form-type screenshot, 'brand' = brand image, 'none' = no style guide, 'any' = works with either kind, 'optional' = with or without. 2026-07-22: added no-guide (p2-5, p5-4, p6-3) and Kind-B brand-image (p4-5, p6-4) prompts to cover the two sourcing-free pilot tracks.

prompts.text: Make this form beautiful.
Redesign this form to match the attached style guide.
Give this form a premium, polished look.
Restyle this form so it feels on-brand with the attached image.
Redesign this form as a multi-step flow with one question per screen and a progress bar at the top. Match the attached style guide.
Redesign this form as a single-page form with all questions visible in one scrollable column. Match the attached style guide.
Redesign this form as a multi-step flow with one question per screen and a progress bar at the top.
Make this a conversational form where questions appear one at a time with a typing-style transition. Follow the attached style guide's visual style.
Redesign this as a single-page form with all questions in one clean scrollable column, clearly grouped into labelled sections.
Follow the attached reference's layout and structure closely, but change the theme to a dark palette with emerald green accents.
Use the same layout as the attached form, but restyle it in a warm cream and terracotta theme.
Copy the attached reference's layout, but apply a minimal black-and-white editorial theme.
Use the brand colors from the attached image and design the form as a single-page card layout.
Extract the color palette from the attached image and build a multi-step form, one question per screen.
Use the attached reference's color palette only — do NOT copy its layout. Design a completely different layout of your choice.
Use this image's palette and typography feel for a compact single-screen form.
Use the color palette from the attached image; choose whatever layout best fits this form.
Design this as a single-column form on a deep navy background with white sans-serif text, gold accent buttons, and rounded cards.
Multi-step form, one question per screen, light warm-gray background, large serif headings in dark green, and a thin progress bar.
Single page, soft pastel pink and lavender gradient background, playful rounded style, big friendly buttons.
Minimal editorial black-and-white: white background, black serif headings, thin rules between sections, and a single bold red accent.
Style this form with a warm, botanical, editorial feel.
Make this feel like a luxury fashion brand.
Make this feel like a trustworthy, modern fintech brand — clean, confident, and professional.
Capture the mood and personality of the attached image; the layout is your choice.
